statement: Frozen workload/parameter/environment/baseline record for ScopeBase resource and performance qualification. Deterministic cap and conservation assertions gate; timing distributions inform and never gate caps. Cross-machine timing comparison is invalid; same-environment relative comparison only.

environment.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 w/ Radeon 890M

metric_interpretation.timing_ns: Wall time per repetition of the whole workload (Instant domain). min/median/mean/max over 21 reps. Reports scheduling noise; a slower run is not a cap failure.
metric_interpretation.ops_per_sec: ops_per_rep divided by mean seconds. Derived display value, not an assertion input.
metric_interpretation.oracle: Deterministic expected value asserted every rep (violation count, settled/refunded bytes). Any mismatch fails the run regardless of timing.
metric_interpretation.memory_note: Overlapping memory metrics (retained vs working vs peak) are reported separately and never summed; additivity is not claimed.
metric_interpretation.time_bound_note: Time caps are asserted on caller-supplied elapsed-ms against per-domain time_ms_cap (see resource.rs check_bounds). A timeout interrupts no syscall and proves no worker/mapping/link retirement.

tt03_pair_launch.reason: No leased live cell on this executor: a pair launch needs TT03 worker images plus an isolated Linux fixture cell with native process authority, which this lane does not hold. Baselines will be recorded by the TT03/live-cell owner, not estimated here.

bpf_live_workload.reason: No privileged BPF cell on this executor: live BPF load/attach/ring workloads need kernel BPF authority and an isolated live-kernel cell. No baseline is claimed; the BP readiness owner registers this gate.

capture_domain_live.reason: No live capture feed bound on this executor: capture-domain resource gates need a real feed owner with measured loss/counter populations. Pure ledger/bounds contracts above cover the harness; live populations stay with the CP owner.
